title: LocalFlow remote identity v1
description: Body of GET /v1/remote/identity on the remote listener (Feature 014). Public, unauthenticated and content-free. The client shows fingerprint at enrollment and pins server_key.

protocol_versions.description: Channel versions this server speaks; [1] today.

server_key.description: The server's raw X25519 public key, base64url without padding (32 bytes).

fingerprint.description: First 16 bytes of SHA-256 over the raw public key as eight groups of four lowercase hex digits joined by '-'.
